title: fix(console): ask the deployment notice, install-local and lookup targets only where the host serves them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UpUNKQM33pdRuJKQSQ8Fuy)_

Fixes #34186
Fixes #34187
Fixes #34188
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:托管环境的控制台不再请求宿主没有提供的三条路由。部署提示只在运行时配置的 `features.deploymentNotice` 为 true 时读取;应用市场目录只在 `features.installLocal` 为 true 时读 install-local;无包应用的页面先用一次批量读探明查找目标是否存在,宿主未注册的对象不再按名读。
- 为什么改:cloud#4300 实测托管控制台每次加载都在网络日志里留下 503/404(部署提示、install-local、`sys_business_unit`)。修在框架里,托管方只需升级框架版本,cloud 侧不用改。
- 风险与回滚:运行时配置多了一个键(只增不减);老服务端不带该键时控制台照旧读取部署提示。无包应用页面的查找目标多一次批量读(每组名字每会话一次)。回滚即整 PR revert,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-plugin.ts`(`hasDeploymentNoticeDoor` 与 features 块)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`(`servedLookupTargets`)、`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service-plugin.ts`(登记部署提示服务那一行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/runtime-config-deployment-notice.test.ts`,预期 3 个用例全绿(挂载自家设置路由的宿主报 false,且提示路由答 503)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**#34186 — the deployment notice is asked only of a host that composes it.**
- `SettingsServicePlugin` registers the notice's door as the kernel service `settings.deployment-notice` (`DEPLOYMENT_NOTICE_SERVICE`) right where it mounts the settings routes with that door. A host that mounts the settings family itself (`registerRoutes: false`, the hosted shape) registers nothing, and its notice route answers `503`.
- `RuntimeConfigPlugin` serves `features.deploymentNotice`, read per request from that registration (`hasDeploymentNoticeDoor`). The key is written after `...features`, so a host's `resolveFeatures` policy can neither claim nor withhold it: it is an observation of the composition, like `installLocal` and `marketplace`, never a host option.
- The CLI's serve path boots the same `RuntimeConfigPlugin` (`Serve.RUNTIME_CONFIG_OPTIONS`), so it serves the key with no change of its own. It is the only producer in this repository.
- Console: `RuntimeFeatures` gains `deploymentNotice`, parsed as `!== false`, so an ABSENT key (a runtime older than this change) reads as true and only an explicit `false` stops the read. `isDeploymentNoticeServed()` joins the other predicates, and `DeploymentNotice` asks the notice only when it is true, after its `isAdmin` gate.
- `packages/spec/**` is untouched: the runtime-config `features` shape is not declared in a spec schema (searched `packages/spec/src`, zero hits).

**#34187 — install-local on the catalog.** The catalog's side load reads `listLocalInstalls()` only when `getRuntimeConfig().features.installLocal` is true, the gate `MarketplacePackagePage` already reads. The other two reads in that `Promise.all` are unchanged, and the list draws as before.

**#34188 — a lookup target the host does not register is never asked by name.**
- New `servedLookupTargets` in `appObjectScope.ts`, used by `readPageObjectScope` and `readObjectRouteNames`. In the names-only arm (an app with no package), the lookup targets the route has not already asked are first asked in ONE `GET /api/v1/meta/object?names=…` read: the existing `batch: true` hand-off (#29444), which leaves an absent object out. Only the targets that answer holds are then read by name. No second read of the whole object list is added.
- A target the route already asks (one of its own bound objects) skips the presence read. The package arm is left as it is, as ordered.
- `MetadataProvider` is not touched.

## Tests

New pins (each red under its ablation; see Verification):
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-deployment-notice.test.ts` (new). It boots the REAL `SettingsServicePlugin` and `RuntimeConfigPlugin` on one kernel-shaped context:
  - with the plugin's door the flag is true;
  - for a host that mounts the settings routes without a door, the notice route answers `503` to an administrator and the flag is false;
  - `resolveFeatures` can neither claim nor withhold the key.
- `ui/.../deployment-notice/__tests__/DeploymentNotice.test.tsx`, new describe "asked only of a host that serves it":
  - true means the notice is asked once and drawn;
  - false means 0 notice requests and nothing drawn;
  - CONTROL: an absent key still asks it.
- `ui/.../marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.installLocalGate-34187.test.tsx` (new). Fetch is stubbed by path, `marketplaceApi` is not mocked:
  - with `installLocal: false` there is no install-local request and the catalog card is drawn;
  - CONTROL: with `true` it is asked.
- `ui/.../console/__tests__/appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx`, new describe for #34188:
  - a page bound to `sys_invitation`, and the object's own route, make no `object/sys_business_unit` request; the only request naming it is the batch `object?names=sys_business_unit,sys_user`;
  - CONTROL: the registered target `sys_user` still resolves (`object/sys_user` asked, scope `sys_invitation,sys_user`).

**Forced test edits.** The new presence read reaches every harness whose app has no package and whose objects carry lookups. Each harness's `getItems` mock read the batch request as a whole-list read, so each now answers `options.names` the way the metadata door does: logging `object?names=…` and returning only those objects. The five files:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx`: mock edit. The existing CONTROL "an app without a package id asks by name" now also expects `object?names=sys_user`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.objectScope-12811.test.tsx`: mock edit. "No `object?` read" became "the only `object?` read is `object?names=sys_user`".
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.packagelessReads-29416.test.tsx`: mock edit only, no assertion changed.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.packagelessRecordRelated-29552.test.tsx`: mock edit. Three read-order expectations gain `object?names=sys_user` before `object/sys_user`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/pageObjectReads-12980.test.tsx`: mock edit. "No `object?` read" became "the only `object?` read is `object?names=crm_account`".

No assertion about a by-name read was dropped.

`check:test-source-alias` judges the test files a change edits. It asked `AppContent.objectScope-12811` and `AppContent.packagelessReads-29416` for a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'`, because `AppContent` reaches a dynamic `import('@objectstack/lint')` through `ConsoleLayout` → `DraftPreviewBar`. That reach predates this PR. Both files now carry the import, following the precedent in `ReportView.drillCallerPackage-32760.test.tsx`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The package arm, and HotCRM's `sys_approval_request`.** The card says the package arm already batches. Measured, it does not: a target its package list does not hold is still read BY NAME. The existing pin "CONTROL: the same lookups drawn ask every target by name" in `appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx` asserts exactly that. Per the order, that arm is unchanged. A HotCRM page on a Free environment is a packaged app, so the cloud#4300 staging note (`sys_approval_request` 404) is most likely NOT covered by this PR. Extending the presence read to the package arm is the follow-up; it is in the report's `open_questions`.
- **Cost of the presence read.** A served lookup target outside the route's own objects now costs a batch read, then its by-name read. That is one more sequential request, once per name set per session; the batch scope's entry is shared. In an app whose bundle holds the target, the by-name read is still answered from the bundle, but the batch read goes to the network, because `getItems({ names })` is not bundle-answered.
- **Out of scope:** an object an app's page names in `requiresObject` that the host does not register is still read by name (`gone_obj` in the 29416 harness). It is the same class on a different path, and none of the three cards names it.

## Verification

Symptoms on main were reproduced by the ablation legs: each reverts one fix to main's code and turns its pin red. They were run under `os-verify-lock`, with each mutation landed and restored through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, and `git diff HEAD` empty after every leg.

<details><summary>Ablations, before/after per card</summary>

| Card | Ablation (main's code) | Before (main) | After (this head) |
|---|---|---|---|
| #34186 server | drop `deploymentNotice: hasDeploymentNoticeDoor(ctx),` | key absent; 3/3 pins red | true with the door, false (and route `503`) without |
| #34186 console | drop `if (!isDeploymentNoticeServed()) return;` | 1 notice request with `deploymentNotice: false`; 1 pin red (17 green) | 0 requests |
| #34187 | side load back to `listLocalInstalls()` | 1 `GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with `installLocal: false`; 1 pin red, CONTROL green | 0 requests |
| #34188 | `servedLookupTargets` returns every target | `object/sys_business_unit` asked on the page and on the object route; 3 red (2 new pins + the amended CONTROL), 9 green | 0 by-name requests; 1 batch `object?names=sys_business_unit,sys_user` |

</details>
